notes.title: Patch 1.6.1 is live
notes.content:

Added missing PL Voiceovers
Added music video 
Bugfixes

Additionally, we would like to inform [b]Apple Silicon[/b] users that we have also updated their versions of the game with additional features included in the previous PC patch (1.5)

[b]New content - Director's Story (Final Prologue)[/b]
Polish Voice-overs
Accessibility - One hand preset
Accessibility - Ability to change the speed of the game
Accessibility - Reduce background sounds during voice-overs
Accessibility - Ability do change the head bob strength
Bugfixes

notes.title: Patch 1.3 is live!
notes.content:
Dear Layers of Fear Fans! We’re happy to announce that Patch 1.3 for
all gaming platforms is live. Many thanks to everyone who gave their feedback!

CHANGELOG:

• The game's achievements system fixes
• Fixing the "Get your Inheritance" achievement
• HDR calibration tool for consoles (and all other changes from the previous PC patch)
• PS5 controller upgrade - additional events with vibrations
• Widescreen support for PC
• Additional sounds and audio fixes in DLC Mother
• Lighting fixes in LoF1
• Animation fixes in LoF1 
• Additional Manequine interactions in LoF2
• Fixes for gameplay with the Flashlight in LoF2
• Collision fixes 
• Added missing VO’s
• Changes in fonts and corrections of language versions
• Bug fixes
• New easter egg added

notes.title: A straightforward explanation of what is Layers of Fear
notes.content:
Layers of Fear, our flagship franchise, will receive a new installment and it is expected to be the crowning work of the series. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42506694/7f5ba1257926ee64f62f35db18789fcffb8fffa1.png[/img]

Our upcoming June premiere cannot be easily categorized as a remake or remaster. Instead, it can be best described as a "reimagination". The team's goal was to pay tribute to the two classic games while also expanding the lore with a fresh story that sheds new light on the events of the first and second Layers. 

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1946700/extras/02c.gif?t=1681473551[/img]

Layers of Fear combines these elements: 
[list]
[*] A full-fledged, revitalized Layers of Fear from 2016
[*] A full-fledged, revitalized Layers of Fear 2 from 2019
[*] The original DLC “Inheritance”
[*] A new protagonist: the Writer
[*] A new story: the Lighthouse
[*] Bonus new content: the “Final Note” chapter
[*] Lantern, a new item that changes the game mechanic
[*] ...and that's not all (we have our secrets) ;)
[/list]
[b]An engrossing story of the Writer set in a lonesome lighthouse will tie the intricate stories of all Layers chapters together. Stay tuned for our next news, as we cover the mechanics of the lantern. 
[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1946700/Layers_of_Fear/
